observations.text: The paper-linked GSEM repository's first public commit is dated 2026-03-21, roughly two days before the paper submission date. That first public tree already contains both the normal forced-fill multi-start retriever and an explicit no-fill counterpart, so the abstention issue is not merely a later post-paper drift in the current branch.

At the first public commit, retriver_multi_start.py documents and implements a forced fallback: when a start path selects no experience, it records the start node into the result. In the same commit, retriver_multi_start_no_fill.py documents its sole behavioral difference as removing that fallback for every start path and allowing the final result to remain empty.

The same first public commit's evaluation/baselines/gsem_ablation_agent.py exposes GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent and labels it 'Ablation 4: multi-start traversal without per-start fallback-to-start.' The first-commit evaluation README also lists this class among the retained GSEM ablations. Thus the authors treated forced fill versus abstention preservation as a separable experimental factor in the pre-submission public lineage.

The inspected paper retrieval ablation table reports entity-recall, embedding-recall and multi-seed variants but not the no-fill Ablation 4. No numeric no-fill outcome was established in the inspected public repository/paper surfaces. Therefore implementation of the matched ablation is evidence that the factor was recognized and testable, not evidence of the direction or magnitude of its performance/safety effect.

protocol_inferences.name: ABLATION_IMPLEMENTATION_IS_NOT_ABLATION_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE
protocol_inferences.text: A matched ablation implementation can establish that a mechanism is separable and testable, but it cannot establish causal benefit or harm until the result is bound to that exact variant/revision.

protocol_inferences.name: ABSTENTION_SEMANTICS_REQUIRE_RESULT_BINDING_BEFORE_CANONICAL_PROMOTION
protocol_inferences.text: The no-fill variant strengthens the structural case for preserving an empty receiver-memory outcome, but canonical protocol promotion should wait for either a bound matched numerical result or an independent source demonstrating the same fail-open fallback failure with outcome evidence.

phase1_acceptance.reason: This is pre-submission implementation provenance for an applicability/abstention design factor, not a zero-dependency scheduled-Chat completion mechanism and not a reported matched outcome result.

scope_notes: Do not claim the paper's experiments ran exactly at commit 137836d79c8f46f5243e4fb57ba611be1635e29b; no evaluated-revision binding was found.
Do not claim no-fill improves or degrades GSEM accuracy/safety; the numerical Ablation 4 outcome remains unobserved in the inspected sources.
The stronger conclusion is limited to public lineage: forced-fill and no-fill variants both existed before paper submission and were explicitly wired as separate evaluation agents.
